scope: Fixed 14-run write protection check pilot: ACTION_WRITE checks FIBF_WRITE in the core's locked write instead of a separate handler inode read. Every scheduled run and both BFS/PFS3 outputs per run (28 outputs total) are retained without filtering; all 23 phases and raw protocol fields are preserved. Ratios are paired only within the scheduled repeat/order. No pooling, outlier exclusion, exclusive-time calculation, or performance-clearance judgment is made.
